outcome: evidence of brain injury on MRI
cohort: 1089 neonates born at or after 35 weeks gestation and weighing at least 1800g, diagnosed with Sarnat stage 1 encephalopathy
finding: Despite longer hospital stays and duration of respiratory support, neonates with mild hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy treated with hypothermia may have a lower risk of brain injury compared to standard care, although selection bias cannot be ruled out.
mod_finding: Neonates born via c-section were more likely to receive hypothermia treatment for mild hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy.
